This is for social media; there is no formatting or titles for posts. Plain text only—no headings, bullets, bold, italics, or emojis.
First sentence should be a strong hook. Posts should focus on giving value to the readers more than direct advertising. Use line breaks or even spacing to break up text and create white space, dense blocks can deter readers. A short, snappy paragraph or a brief list is easier to scan than a long chunk of text. Keep each paragraph to 1–3 sentences to maintain visual appeal in the feed.
No hashtags necessary. Use 0-3.
Post very early in the morning, between 5-7am.
